title: Keralam CM congratulates Vidarsha Vinod on Asian Games shooting silver medal
summary: At the start of her foray into air rifle shooting, Vidarsha Vinod braved several odds, including a severe lack of essential sporting equipment, which forced her parents to take out a loan to buy an expensive air rifle and shooting jackets.

title: Local body elections will lay a strong foundation for Jana Sena Party in Srikakulam district: JSP leader
summary: Daneti Sridhar said that the Party State President and Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan and the Party Political Affairs Committee Chairman Nadendla Manohar had issued guidelines with regard to local body elections

title: Hyena gave birth to two cubs at the Thiruvananthapuram Zoo
summary: The zoo had sourced three Hyenas, two jackals, two marsh crocodiles, and two palm civets from Shivamogga Zoological Park in Karnataka in 2024

title: SCoR, Vijayawada division, loads first rake of wood pulp to Maharashtra
summary: Wood pulp is expected to generate around 1.5 lakh tonnes of additional loading, and estimated annual freight revenue is about ₹20 crore on the new commodity, the Railway officials said

title: BJP-RSS have hollowed out the education system, Rahul Gandhi standing with students: Congress
summary: Rahul Gandhi told participants in Indore that the ‘system’ fears students who ask questions, while Jairam Ramesh said the BJP-RSS have corrupted education

title: Nearly 800 families struggle to enter their homes in Parvatipuram-Manyam district
summary: As part of the developmental works, the officials removed steps, ramps of houses and encroachments on drainage eight months ago; now people face difficulty moving in and out of their houses

title: Complete Ring Road works by December, says Minister Janardhan Reddy
summary: The Minister noted that the completion of the Ring Road would provide a permanent solution to the ever-increasing traffic problems in Banaganapalle town

title: Overnight rain bring temperatures down in Bengaluru, KIA records 94.2 mm
summary: The rainfall brought down the temperature by a few degrees Celsius which had been hovering above 30°C for the last couple of weeks.
